function keyToItem(currentItemIndex, previousItemIndex, originalInputValue) {
var currentItem = document.getElementById('suggestion-item-' + currentItemIndex);
var previousItem = document.getElementById('suggestion-item-' + previousItemIndex);
if(currentItem) {
currentItem.classList.add('bg-selected');
}
if(previousItem) {
previousItem.classList.remove('bg-selected');
}
var input = document.querySelector('.js-search-input');
if (currentItemIndex === -1) {
input.value = originalInputValue;
} else if(document.getElementsByClassName('js-suggestionitem')[currentItemIndex]) {
var newInputValue = document.getElementsByClassName('js-suggestionitem')[currentItemIndex].innerText;
input.value = newInputValue;
}
}
var input = document.querySelector('.js-search-input');
var currentItemIndex = -1;
var originalInputValue = '';
if(input) {
input.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
event.preventDefault();
var suggestionItems = document.querySelectorAll('.category-brand .item');
var selectedItem;
var previousItemIndex = currentItemIndex;
if (!event.shiftKey) { // allow for shift+arrow text highlighting
switch (event.key) {
case 'Escape':
input.blur();
break;
case 'Left': // for IE/Edge - empty case
case 'ArrowLeft': // empty case
case 'Right': // for IE/Edge - empty case
case 'ArrowRight':
selectedItem = document.querySelector('.bg-selected');
if (selectedItem) {
selectedItem.classList.remove('bg-selected');
}
currentItemIndex = -1;
break;
case 'Up': // for IE/Edge - empty case
case 'ArrowUp':
if (suggestionItems.length > 0) {
if(currentItemIndex === -1) {
currentItemIndex = suggestionItems.length - 1;
} else {
currentItemIndex--;
}
keyToItem(currentItemIndex, previousItemIndex, originalInputValue);
}
break;
case 'Down': // for IE/Edge - empty case
case 'ArrowDown':
if (suggestionItems.length > 0) {
if(currentItemIndex === suggestionItems.length - 1) {
currentItemIndex = -1;
} else {
currentItemIndex++;
}
keyToItem(currentItemIndex, previousItemIndex, originalInputValue);
}
break;
default: // Non-arrow/escape keys
currentItemIndex = -1;
originalInputValue = input.value;
break;
}
}
})
};

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const subnavwrap = document.querySelector(".subnavwrap");
  const subnavItems = document.querySelectorAll(".subnav li");
  const leftArrow = document.querySelector(".subnav-left-arrow");
  const rightArrow = document.querySelector(".subnav-right-arrow");

  leftArrow.addEventListener("click", () => {
    subnavwrap.scrollBy({ left: -133, behavior: "smooth" });
  });

  rightArrow.addEventListener("click", () => {
    subnavwrap.scrollBy({ left: 133, behavior: "smooth" });
  });

  function updateArrowVisibility() {
    const maxScrollLeft = subnavwrap.scrollWidth - subnavwrap.clientWidth;
    leftArrow.style.display = subnavwrap.scrollLeft > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
    rightArrow.style.display = subnavwrap.scrollLeft < maxScrollLeft ? 'flex' : 'none';
  }

  subnavwrap.addEventListener("scroll", updateArrowVisibility);
  window.addEventListener("resize", updateArrowVisibility);
  updateArrowVisibility();

  subnavItems.forEach((item) => {
    item.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      const link = e.target.closest("a");
      const hasDropdown = this.querySelector("ul.dropdown");

      if (!hasDropdown || (link && !link.nextElementSibling)) return;

      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();

      const isOpen = this.classList.contains("show");
      const parentList = this.parentElement;

      parentList.querySelectorAll(":scope > li.show").forEach((sibling) => {
        if (sibling !== this) sibling.classList.remove("show");
      });

      this.classList.toggle("show", !isOpen);

      const dropdown = this.querySelector("ul.dropdown");
      if (dropdown) {
        const parentRect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const containerRect = subnavwrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        dropdown.style.left = window.innerWidth > 768
          ? `${parentRect.left - containerRect.left}px`
          : `0px`;
        dropdown.style.top = `2rem`;
      }
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest(".subnav")) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".subnav li.show").forEach((item) =>
        item.classList.remove("show")
      );
    }
  });

  let isScrolling;
  subnavwrap.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
    clearTimeout(isScrolling);
    isScrolling = setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".subnav li.show").forEach((item) =>
        item.classList.remove("show")
      );
    }, 50);
  });
let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
  window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    const currentScroll = window.scrollY;
    if (Math.abs(currentScroll - lastScrollY) > 100) {
      subnavItems.forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("show"));
      lastScrollY = currentScroll;
    }
  });

});
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  const ASSET_ID = "hp-hero-po-tcg-1113026";
  const root = document.getElementById('hero-scroll-' + ASSET_ID);
  if (!root || root.getAttribute('data-hero-initialized') === 'true') return;
  const slideData = document.getElementById('hero-slide-data-' + ASSET_ID);
  if (!slideData) return;

  // The prototype below builds HTML strings. Escape the decoded CMS values
  // before inserting them into those strings so quotes and query strings work.
  const escapeHTML = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({
    '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": '''
  }[character]));

  const slides = Array.from(slideData.querySelectorAll('[data-hero-slide]')).map((slide) => ({
    url: escapeHTML(slide.getAttribute('data-image-url')),
    alt: escapeHTML(slide.getAttribute('data-alt-text')),
    href: escapeHTML(slide.getAttribute('data-link-url')),
    target: slide.getAttribute('data-open-in-new-tab') === 'true' ? '_blank' : '_self'
  })).filter(s => s.url);

  if (!slides.length) return;
  root.setAttribute('data-hero-initialized', 'true');
  slideData.remove();
  const AUTOPLAY = root.getAttribute('data-autoplay') === 'true';

  const DESKTOP_SPEED_PX_PER_SEC = 90;
  const DESKTOP_IMG_HEIGHT = 300; // must match the height set in CSS for #infinite-desktop-track-hp-hero-po-tcg-1113026 a
  const DESKTOP_GAP = 18; // must match the gap set in CSS for #infinite-desktop-track-hp-hero-po-tcg-1113026
  const DESKTOP_ASPECT_RATIO = 400 / 300; // confirmed standard desktop hero banner crop ratio
  const ARROW_NUDGE_DISTANCE_PX = 418;
  const ARROW_NUDGE_DURATION_MS = 500;
  const DRAG_CLICK_SUPPRESS_THRESHOLD = 5;

  const MOBILE_TILE_WIDTH_FRACTION = 0.82;
  const MOBILE_GAP = 12;
  const MOBILE_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS = 3000;
  const MOBILE_TRANSITION_MS = 400;
  const MOBILE_SWIPE_THRESHOLD_FRACTION = 0.2;
  const MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE = 36;
  const MOBILE_CONTROL_STROKE = 3;



  const setupMobilePeekCarousel = (items) => {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'mobile-slide-carousel-' + ASSET_ID;

    const viewport = document.createElement('div');
    viewport.id = 'mobile-slide-viewport-' + ASSET_ID;

    const track = document.createElement('div');
    track.id = 'mobile-slide-track-' + ASSET_ID;

    const extended = [...items, ...items, ...items];
    track.innerHTML = extended.map((i, idx) => {
      const isFirstVisible = idx === items.length;
      return `
      <a href="${i.href}" ${i.target === '_blank' ? 'target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : ''}
         style="flex:0 0 auto; display:block;">
        <img src="${i.url}" alt="${i.alt}" ${isFirstVisible ? 'fetchpriority="high"' : ''}>
      </a>
    `;
    }).join('');

    viewport.appendChild(track);
    wrap.appendChild(viewport);

    const radius = (MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE - MOBILE_CONTROL_STROKE) / 2;
    const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;

    const control = document.createElement('button');
    control.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play slideshow');
    control.style.cssText = `
      position:absolute; bottom:24px; right:6px;
      width:${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE}px; height:${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE}px;
      border:none; border-radius:50%; padding:0; cursor:pointer;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      z-index:10;
    `;
    control.innerHTML = `
      <svg width="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE}" height="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE}"
           style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; transform:rotate(-90deg);">
        <circle cx="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE / 2}" cy="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE / 2}" r="${radius}"
          fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.3)" stroke-width="${MOBILE_CONTROL_STROKE}"/>
        <circle class="mslide-progress-ring" cx="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE / 2}" cy="${MOBILE_CONTROL_SIZE / 2}" r="${radius}"
          fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="${MOBILE_CONTROL_STROKE}"
          stroke-dasharray="${circumference}" stroke-dashoffset="0" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="mslide-icon" style="display:flex; pointer-events:none;">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>
      </span>
    `;
    wrap.appendChild(control);
    root.appendChild(wrap);

    const progressRing = control.querySelector('.mslide-progress-ring');
    const iconEl = control.querySelector('.mslide-icon');

    let tileWidth = 0;
    let stepWidth = 0;
    let currentIndex = items.length;
    let isDragging = false;
    let dragStartX = 0;
    let dragBaseTranslate = 0;
    let dragCurrentTranslate = 0;
    let isPaused = true;
    let progressRAF = null;
    let progressStart = null;
    let progressRemaining = MOBILE_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS;

    const setPosition = (index, animate = true) => {
      track.style.transition = animate ? `transform ${MOBILE_TRANSITION_MS}ms ease` : 'none';
      track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-index * stepWidth}px, 0, 0)`;
    };

    const setTileSizes = () => {
      const viewportWidth = wrap.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      tileWidth = viewportWidth * MOBILE_TILE_WIDTH_FRACTION;
      stepWidth = tileWidth + MOBILE_GAP;
      [...track.children].forEach(el => {
        el.style.width = `${tileWidth}px`;
        el.style.marginRight = `${MOBILE_GAP}px`;
      });
      setPosition(currentIndex, false);
    };

    const normalizeIndex = () => {
      if (currentIndex >= items.length * 2) {
        currentIndex -= items.length;
        setPosition(currentIndex, false);
      } else if (currentIndex < items.length) {
        currentIndex += items.length;
        setPosition(currentIndex, false);
      }
    };
    track.addEventListener('transitionend', normalizeIndex);

    const goTo = (index) => { currentIndex = index; setPosition(currentIndex, true); };
    const next = () => goTo(currentIndex + 1);
    const prev = () => goTo(currentIndex - 1);

    const stepProgress = (ts) => {
      if (progressStart === null) progressStart = ts;
      const elapsed = ts - progressStart;
      const fraction = Math.min(elapsed / progressRemaining, 1);
      progressRing.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', String(circumference * fraction));
      if (fraction < 1) {
        progressRAF = requestAnimationFrame(stepProgress);
      } else {
        next();
        progressStart = null;
        progressRemaining = MOBILE_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS;
        progressRing.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', '0');
        progressRAF = requestAnimationFrame(stepProgress);
      }
    };

    const startProgress = () => {
      progressStart = null;
      progressRAF = requestAnimationFrame(stepProgress);
    };
    const stopProgress = () => {
      if (progressRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(progressRAF);
      if (progressStart !== null) {
        const elapsedAtPause = performance.now() - progressStart;
        progressRemaining = Math.max(progressRemaining - elapsedAtPause, 0);
      }
    };

    const setPaused = (paused) => {
      isPaused = paused;
      if (paused) {
        stopProgress();
        iconEl.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>';
        control.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play slideshow');
      } else {
        startProgress();
        iconEl.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16"/></svg>';
        control.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause slideshow');
      }
    };

    control.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      setPaused(!isPaused);
    });

    wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
      isDragging = true;
      dragStartX = e.clientX;
      dragBaseTranslate = -currentIndex * stepWidth;
      dragCurrentTranslate = dragBaseTranslate;
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onWindowPointerMove);
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onWindowPointerUp);
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onWindowPointerUp);
    });

    function onWindowPointerMove(e) {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const delta = e.clientX - dragStartX;
      dragCurrentTranslate = dragBaseTranslate + delta;
      track.style.transform = `translate3d(${dragCurrentTranslate}px, 0, 0)`;
    }

    function onWindowPointerUp() {
      endDrag();
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onWindowPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onWindowPointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onWindowPointerUp);
    }

    const endDrag = () => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      isDragging = false;
      const delta = dragCurrentTranslate - dragBaseTranslate;
      if (Math.abs(delta) > tileWidth * MOBILE_SWIPE_THRESHOLD_FRACTION) {
        delta < 0 ? next() : prev();
      } else {
        goTo(currentIndex);
      }
      if (!isPaused) {
        progressStart = null;
        progressRemaining = MOBILE_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS;
      }
    };

    let resizeTimeout = null;
    const debouncedSetTileSizes = () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
      resizeTimeout = setTimeout(setTileSizes, 100);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', debouncedSetTileSizes);
    setTileSizes();
    if (AUTOPLAY) setPaused(false);
  };

  const setupDesktopStrip = (items) => {
    const desktopWrap = document.createElement('div');
    desktopWrap.id = 'infinite-desktop-carousel-' + ASSET_ID;

    const desktopTrack = document.createElement('div');
    desktopTrack.id = 'infinite-desktop-track-' + ASSET_ID;

    // Calculated purely from the confirmed 551:413 crop convention and the
    // fixed tile height — no DOM measurement or image load required to know
    // this value, since every desktop banner is cropped to this ratio.
    const calculatedTileWidth = DESKTOP_IMG_HEIGHT * DESKTOP_ASPECT_RATIO;

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var root = document.querySelector('[data-creative-name="dropsWidgetTestV2"]');
  if (!root) return;

  /* ---------- settings ---------- */
  var TZ = 'America/Chicago';
  var MAX_VISIBLE = 20;                    // banners shown per tab
  var MAX_VISIBLE_ALL = Infinity;          // All tab: every live banner from every tab (the 60KB limit already bounds the total)
  var LIVE_LEAD_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;       // flip to "Available Now" 1h before midnight CT of the release date
  var EXPIRE_AFTER_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // drop the banner 24h after midnight CT of the release date
  var REFRESH_MS = 60 * 1000;

  /* ---------- Central Time helpers ---------- */
  function tzOffsetMinutes(utcMs) {
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: TZ, timeZoneName: 'shortOffset' }).formatToParts(new Date(utcMs));
      var tz = parts.filter(function (p) { return p.type === 'timeZoneName'; })[0];
      var m = tz && tz.value.match(/GMT([+-]\d+)(?::(\d+))?/);
      if (m) {
        var h = parseInt(m[1], 10);
        var min = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 0;
        return h * 60 + (h < 0 ? -min : min);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return -360; // fallback: CST
  }
  function centralMidnight(y, mo, d) {
    var naive = Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d, 0, 0, 0);
    var off = tzOffsetMinutes(naive);
    var ms = naive - off * 60000;
    var off2 = tzOffsetMinutes(ms);
    return off2 === off ? ms : naive - off2 * 60000;
  }

  /* ---------- elements ---------- */
  var tabList = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dd-panel[data-dd-panel]')).map(function (panel) {
    var id = panel.getAttribute('data-dd-panel');
    return {
      id: id,
      panel: panel,
      scroller: panel.querySelector('.dd-scroll'),
      btn: root.querySelector('.dd-tab[data-dd-tab="' + id + '"]'),
      max: id === 'all' ? MAX_VISIBLE_ALL : MAX_VISIBLE,
      items: [],
      count: 0
    };
  });
  var byId = function (id) { return tabList.filter(function (t) { return t.id === id; })[0]; };
  var prevBtn = root.querySelector('[data-dd-prev]');
  var nextBtn = root.querySelector('[data-dd-next]');
  var pill = root.querySelector('.dd-pill');
  var wrap = root.querySelector('.dd-wrap');
  var tabLeft = root.querySelector('[data-dd-tab-left]');
  var tabRight = root.querySelector('[data-dd-tab-right]');
  var activeId = null;
  var updateVideo = function () {};

  /* ---------- banner prep / sort ---------- */
  function prep(el, tabIndex, pos) {
    // the release date (YYYY-MM-DD) is rendered once, as the text of .dd-date; the script replaces it
    var dateEl = el.querySelector('.dd-date');
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(dateEl ? dateEl.textContent.trim() : '');
    el._dd = {
      tab: tabIndex,   // which tab the banner belongs to (tab order)
      pos: pos,        // its position inside that tab (the order it was added in the CMS)
      rel: m ? centralMidnight(+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]) : null,
      label: m ? m[2] + '.' + m[3] + ' at 12am ET' : '',   // e.g. 11.06 at 12am ET (midnight ET = 11pm CT, when the banner goes live)
      dateEl: dateEl
    };
  }
  // soonest first. Same day: earlier tab first, then the order the banners were added in that tab.
  // Banners are never dropped for sharing a date or an image.
  function byDate(a, b) {
    var ra = a._dd.rel, rb = b._dd.rel;
    if (ra !== rb) {
      if (ra === null) return 1;
      if (rb === null) return -1;
      return ra - rb;
    }
    return (a._dd.tab - b._dd.tab) || (a._dd.pos - b._dd.pos);
  }

  var allTab = byId('all');
  var tabIndex = 0;
  tabList.forEach(function (t) {
    if (t.id === 'all') return;
    [].slice.call(t.scroller.querySelectorAll('.dd-banner')).forEach(function (el, pos) {
      prep(el, tabIndex, pos);
      t.items.push(el);
      if (allTab) {
        var clone = el.cloneNode(true);   // the All tab gets a copy of every banner
        prep(clone, tabIndex, pos);
        allTab.items.push(clone);
      }
    });
    tabIndex++;
  });
  tabList.forEach(function (t) {
    t.items.sort(byDate);
    t.items.forEach(function (el) { t.scroller.appendChild(el); });
  });

  /* ---------- state refresh (sort is static; live / expired / cap are time based) ---------- */
  function refresh() {
    var now = Date.now();
    tabList.forEach(function (t) {
      var shown = 0;
      t.items.forEach(function (el) {
        var d = el._dd;
        var live = d.rel !== null && now >= d.rel - LIVE_LEAD_MS;
        var expired = d.rel !== null && now >= d.rel + EXPIRE_AFTER_MS;
        var visible = !expired && shown < t.max;
        if (visible) shown++;
        el.hidden = !visible;
        if (d.dateEl) {
          var text = live ? 'Available Now' : d.label;
          if (d.dateEl.textContent !== text) d.dateEl.textContent = text;
        }
      });
      t.count = shown;
      if (t.btn) t.btn.hidden = shown === 0;
    });
    // All only makes sense with two or more live tabs; with one it would just repeat that tab
    var liveTabs = tabList.filter(function (t) { return t.id !== 'all' && t.count > 0; }).length;
    if (allTab && liveTabs < 2) {
      allTab.count = 0;
      if (allTab.btn) allTab.btn.hidden = true;
    }
    var current = byId(activeId);
    if (!current || current.count === 0) {
      // default to All when it is showing, otherwise the first tab that has live banners
      var first = (allTab && allTab.count > 0) ? allTab : tabList.filter(function (t) { return t.count > 0; })[0];
      if (first) setActive(first.id);
    }
    root.hidden = !tabList.some(function (t) { return t.count > 0; });
    syncArrows();
    updatePill();
    updateVideo();
  }

  /* ---------- tabs ---------- */
  function setActive(id) {
    activeId = id;
    tabList.forEach(function (t) {
      var on = t.id === id;
      if (t.btn) {
        t.btn.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        t.btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      }
      t.panel.hidden = !on;
    });
    var act = byId(id);
    if (act && act.btn) revealTab(act.btn);
    syncArrows();
    setTimeout(syncArrows, 60);
    updateVideo();
  }
  // scroll the tab row so the active tab is in view (matters on phones, where the row scrolls)
  function revealTab(btn) {
    var left = btn.offsetLeft - wrap.offsetLeft;
    var right = left + btn.offsetWidth;
    if (left < wrap.scrollLeft) wrap.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, left - 24);
    else if (right > wrap.scrollLeft + wrap.clientWidth) wrap.scrollLeft = right - wrap.clientWidth + 24;
  }
  tabList.forEach(function (t) {
    if (t.btn) t.btn.addEventListener('click', function () { setActive(t.id); });
    t.scroller.addEventListener('scroll', syncArrows, { passive: true });
  });

  /* ---------- header arrows (same behavior as the existing carousels) ---------- */
  function activeScroller() {
    var t = byId(activeId);
    return t ? t.scroller : null;
  }
  function scrollDistance(s) {
    var b = s.querySelector('.dd-banner:not([hidden])');
    if (!b) return s.clientWidth;
    var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(s).columnGap) || 0;
    var w = b.offsetWidth + gap;
    return w * Math.max(1, Math.round(s.clientWidth / w));
  }
  function syncArrows() {
    var s = activeScroller();
    if (!s) {
      prevBtn.classList.add('is-disabled');
      nextBtn.classList.add('is-disabled');
      return;
    }
    var max = s.scrollWidth - s.clientWidth;
    prevBtn.classList.toggle('is-disabled', s.scrollLeft <= 0);
    nextBtn.classList.toggle('is-disabled', s.scrollLeft >= max - 20);
  }
  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var s = activeScroller();
    if (s && !prevBtn.classList.contains('is-disabled')) s.scrollBy({ left: -scrollDistance(s), behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var s = activeScroller();
    if (s && !nextBtn.classList.contains('is-disabled')) s.scrollBy({ left: scrollDistance(s), behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  /* ---------- tab row overflow (scroll buttons + edge fades) ---------- */
  function updatePill() {
    var overflowing = wrap.scrollWidth > wrap.offsetWidth + 2;
    pill.classList.toggle('has-overflow', overflowing);
    tabLeft.classList.toggle('visible', overflowing);
    tabRight.classList.toggle('visible', overflowing);
    if (overflowing) {
      var atStart = wrap.scrollLeft <= 1;
      var atEnd = wrap.scrollLeft >= wrap.scrollWidth - wrap.clientWidth - 1;
      pill.classList.toggle('at-start', atStart);
      pill.classList.toggle('at-end', atEnd);
      tabLeft.disabled = atStart;
      tabRight.disabled = atEnd;
    }
  }
  tabLeft.addEventListener('click', function () { wrap.scrollBy({ left: -120, behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  tabRight.addEventListener('click', function () { wrap.scrollBy({ left: 120, behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  wrap.addEventListener('scroll', updatePill, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { updatePill(); syncArrows(); });

  /* ---------- background video: content first ---------- */
  function setupBackgroundVideo() {
    var video = root.querySelector('.dd-video');
    if (!video) return;

    var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
    var motion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var pageReady = false;
    var inView = !('IntersectionObserver' in window);
    var frame = 0;
    video.muted = true;
    video.defaultMuted = true;

    function canStart() {
      if (!pageReady || !inView || document.hidden || root.hidden || motion.matches) return false;
      var rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < window.innerHeight &&
        rect.right > 0 && rect.left < window.innerWidth && getComputedStyle(root).visibility === 'visible';
    }

    // Only wait for images currently visible in the active carousel. Hidden tabs
    // and offscreen lazy images must not hold up the background indefinitely.
    function visibleImages() {
      var scroller = activeScroller();
      if (!scroller) return [];
      var bounds = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
      return [].slice.call(scroller.querySelectorAll('.dd-banner:not([hidden]) img')).filter(function (img) {
        var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 &&
          rect.right > Math.max(0, bounds.left) && rect.left < Math.min(window.innerWidth, bounds.right) &&
          rect.bottom > Math.max(0, bounds.top) && rect.top < Math.min(window.innerHeight, bounds.bottom);
      });
    }

    function imageReady(img) {
      if (!img.complete) return false;
      // A failed image should not prevent the remaining content from working.
      if (!img.naturalWidth || !img.decode) return true;
      var src = img.currentSrc || img.src;
      var state = img._ddVideoDecode;
      if (state && state.src === src) return state.ready;
      state = img._ddVideoDecode = { src: src, ready: false };
      img.decode().catch(function () {}).then(function () {
        state.ready = true;
        updateVideo();
      });
      return false;
    }

    function syncVideo() {
      if (!canStart()) { video.pause(); return; }
      var next = video.getAttribute(mq.matches ? 'data-src-mobile' : 'data-src-desktop');
      if (!next) return;
      if (video.getAttribute('src') !== next) {
        var ready = true;
        visibleImages().forEach(function (img) { if (!imageReady(img)) ready = false; });
        if (!ready) return;
        // This is the first point where the browser receives a fetchable video URL.
        video.setAttribute('src', next);
        video.load();
      }
      if (video.paused) {
        var p = video.play();
        if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
      }
    }

    updateVideo = function () {
      // Pause immediately, even when a hidden browser tab stops animation frames.
      if (document.hidden || root.hidden || motion.matches || !inView) video.pause();
      if (frame) return;
      // Allow a paint between content readiness and assigning the video source.
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
          frame = 0;
          syncVideo();
        });
      });
    };

    function listen(query) {
      if (query.addEventListener) query.addEventListener('change', updateVideo);
      else if (query.addListener) query.addListener(updateVideo);
    }
    listen(mq);
    listen(motion);
    root.addEventListener('load', updateVideo, true);
    root.addEventListener('error', updateVideo, true);
    root.addEventListener('scroll', updateVideo, true);
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateVideo);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', updateVideo);
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        inView = entries[0].isIntersecting;
        updateVideo();
      }).observe(root);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('scroll', updateVideo, true);
    }

    function afterPageLoad() {
      var fontsReady = document.fonts ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();
      fontsReady.then(function () {
        pageReady = true;
        updateVideo();
      });
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') afterPageLoad();
    else window.addEventListener('load', afterPageLoad, { once: true });
  }

  /* ---------- go ---------- */
  refresh();
  var startTab = byId(activeId);
  if (startTab && startTab.btn) revealTab(startTab.btn);   // once, after the tab row's scroll buttons have been laid out
  root.setAttribute('data-dd-ready', '');
  setupBackgroundVideo();
  setInterval(refresh, REFRESH_MS);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (!document.hidden) refresh(); });
  root.addEventListener('dd:refresh', refresh); // lets the test page force a re-check

          </div>

    <script>
    (() => {
      const HOTSPOTS_URL   = "https://cdn.c1.amplience.net/c/gamestop/GameStop2026HolidayGiftGuide_hotspots5";
      const IMAGE_BASE     = "https://media.gamestop.com/i/gamestop/";
      const TOTAL_PAGES    = 32;
      const MOBILE_BP      = 900;
      const INITIAL_EAGER  = 3;

      const SHOW_SPINE_ON_SINGLE = false;
      const HEADER_FOOTER_OFFSET = 182;

      const iPath = i => `${IMAGE_BASE}GameStop2026HolidayGiftGuide_Page_${String(i).padStart(2,'0')}`;
      const rICB  = window.requestIdleCallback || (cb => setTimeout(cb, 50));

      const book     = document.getElementById('book');
      const box      = book.querySelector('.book_container');
      const controls = book.querySelector('.controls');
      const startBt  = document.getElementById('startBtn');
      const prevBt   = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
      const nextBt   = document.getElementById('nextBtn');
      const fsBtn    = document.getElementById('fsBtn');

      const spineEl  = box.querySelector('.spine');
      const edgeLEl  = box.querySelector('.edgeL');
      const edgeREl  = box.querySelector('.edgeR');

      const readVar = (n, el=book) => getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const num = v => { const n=parseFloat(String(v).replace(/[^\d.\-]+/g,'')); return isNaN(n)?0:n; };

      // Get tracking label from URL = last path segment
      function getTrackingText(href){
        try {
          const u = new URL(href);
          const segments = u.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
          return segments.length ? segments[segments.length - 1] : href;
        } catch (e) {
          // Fallback for non-standard URLs
          let clean = href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
          clean = clean.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
          const parts = clean.split('/').filter(Boolean);
          return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : href;
        }
      }

      let PAGE_RATIO   = num(readVar('--page-ratio'));
      let SPREAD_RATIO = PAGE_RATIO * 2;

      const state = {
        single: innerWidth < MOBILE_BP,
        spread: 0,
        page:   1,
        nodes: {},
        loaded: new Set(),
        tailFillerIndex: null,
        hotspots: [],
        ratiosFixed: false
      };
      box.classList.toggle('single', state.single);

      init();

      async function init(){
        state.hotspots = await loadHotspots();
        buildPages();
        await correctAspectFromFirstImage();
        setBookWidthFromVH();
        state.single ? layoutSingle(state.page) : layoutSpread(state.spread, 0);
        updateButtons();
        wireControls();
        warmPreload();
        ensureSpineVisibility();
        addEventListener('resize', onResize, {passive:true});
        document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFullscreenChange);
        // document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown, {passive:true});

        window.flipbook = {
          setBookWidthFromVH,
          ensureSpineVisibility,
          updateButtons,
          layoutSingle,
          layoutSpread,
          state,
          book, box
        };
      }

      async function loadHotspots(){
        if (window.BOOK_HOTSPOTS?.pages) return window.BOOK_HOTSPOTS.pages;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(HOTSPOTS_URL, { mode:'cors', cache:'no-store' });
          const txt = await res.text();
          try { const j = JSON.parse(txt); return normalize(j); }
          catch { new Function(txt)(); return window.BOOK_HOTSPOTS?.pages || []; }
        } catch { return []; }
      }
      function normalize(o){
        if (o?.pages) return o.pages;
        if (o?.content?.pages) return o.content.pages;
        return [];
      }

      function buildPages(){
        const needsTail = (TOTAL_PAGES % 2 === 0);
        state.tailFillerIndex = needsTail ? TOTAL_PAGES + 1 : null;

        for (let idx = 0; idx <= (state.tailFillerIndex || TOTAL_PAGES); idx++){
          const page = document.createElement('div');
          page.className = 'page ' + (idx % 2 ? 'right' : 'left');
          page.dataset.page = String(idx);

          if (idx === 0 || idx === state.tailFillerIndex){
            page.classList.add('blank');
          } else {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.decoding = 'async';
            img.loading  = idx <= INITIAL_EAGER ? 'eager' : 'lazy';
            img.src = iPath(idx);
            page.appendChild(img);

            const hs = document.createElement('div');
            hs.className = 'hotspots';
            page.appendChild(hs);

            attachHotspots(idx, hs);
          }
          box.appendChild(page);
          state.nodes[idx] = page;
        }
      }

      function attachHotspots(idx, layer){
        const p = state.hotspots[idx - 1];
        if (!p?.links) return;
        const { w, h, origin = 'pdf' } = p;

        p.links.forEach(l => {
          const [x1,y1,x2,y2] = l.rect;
          const tlX = Math.min(x1,x2);
          const wid = Math.abs(x2-x1);
          const hei = Math.abs(y2-y1);
          const tlY = origin === 'pdf' ? (h - Math.max(y1,y2)) : Math.min(y1,y2);

          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = l.href;
          a.target = '_blank';
          a.rel = 'noopener';

          a.style.left   = (tlX / w * 100) + '%';
          a.style.top    = (tlY / h * 100) + '%';
          a.style.width  = (wid / w * 100) + '%';
          a.style.height = (hei / h * 100) + '%';

          const trackingText = l.trackingText || getTrackingText(l.href || '');

          if (trackingText) {
            const span = document.createElement('span');
            span.className = 'qm-label';
            span.textContent = trackingText;
            a.appendChild(span);
          }

          layer.appendChild(a);
        });
      }

      function correctAspectFromFirstImage(){
        return new Promise(resolve => {
          const first = state.nodes[1]?.querySelector('img');
          if (!first){ resolve(); return; }
          const apply = () => {
            if (!first.naturalWidth) { resolve(); return; }
            const r = first.naturalWidth / first.naturalHeight;
            if (Math.abs(r - PAGE_RATIO) > 0.001){
              PAGE_RATIO   = r;
              SPREAD_RATIO = r * 2;
              book.style.setProperty('--page-ratio',   r.toString());
              book.style.setProperty('--spread-ratio', (r*2).toString());
            }
            state.ratiosFixed = true;
            resolve();
          };
          if (first.complete) apply(); else first.addEventListener('load', apply, {once:true});
        });
      }

      function setBookWidthFromVH(){
        const isFS = !!document.fullscreenElement || book.classList.contains('fullscreen-active');

        const csBook = getComputedStyle(book);
        const padV = (parseFloat(csBook.paddingTop)||0) + (parseFloat(csBook.paddingBottom)||0);

        const headerOffset = isFS ? 0 : HEADER_FOOTER_OFFSET;

        const csCtrl = getComputedStyle(controls);
        const controlsH = (controls.offsetHeight || 0) + (parseFloat(csCtrl.marginTop)||0);

        const usableH = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - headerOffset - padV - controlsH);
        const ratio   = state.single ? PAGE_RATIO : SPREAD_RATIO;

        const capFromHeight   = usableH * ratio;
        const capFromVHSafety = (isFS ? 2.5 : 1.5) * window.innerHeight;
        const capFromViewport = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - (isFS ? 16 : 32));
        const capAbsolute     = isFS ? 4096 : 1200;

        const bookW = Math.floor(Math.min(capFromHeight, capFromVHSafety, capFromViewport, capAbsolute));
        book.style.setProperty('--bookW', bookW + 'px');
      }

      function getMaxSpreadIndex(){
        const last = state.tailFillerIndex || TOTAL_PAGES;
        const spreadCount = Math.ceil(last / 2);
        return Math.max(0, spreadCount - 1);
      }

      function goToStart(){
        if (state.single){ state.page=1; layoutSingle(1); }
        else { state.spread=0; layoutSpread(0, 0); }
        updateButtons(); warmPreload(); ensureSpineVisibility();
      }

      function go(dir){
        if (state.single){
          const np = state.page + dir; if (np<1 || np>TOTAL_PAGES) return;
          state.page = np; layoutSingle(state.page);
        } else {
          const maxIdx = getMaxSpreadIndex();
          const ns = Math.min(Math.max(0, state.spread + dir), maxIdx);
          if (ns === state.spread) return;
          state.spread = ns; layoutSpread(state.spread, dir);
        }
        updateButtons(); warmPreload(); ensureSpineVisibility();
      }

      function layoutSpread(s, dir = 0){
        for (const k in state.nodes){
          const el = state.nodes[k];
          el.style.display='none';
          el.classList.remove('turning-next','turning-prev');
        }

        const L = (s===0)?0:s*2, R = (s===0)?1:s*2+1;
        const left  = state.nodes[L], right = state.nodes[R];

        if (left)  left.style.display='block';
        if (right) right.style.display='block';

        if (dir > 0 && right){
          right.classList.add('turning-next');
          setTimeout(() => right.classList.remove('turning-next'), 420);
        } else if (dir < 0 && left){
          left.classList.add('turning-prev');
          setTimeout(() => left.classList.remove('turning-prev'), 420);
        }

        box.classList.toggle('at-start', s===0);
        box.classList.toggle('at-end',   s>=getMaxSpreadIndex());

        const leftReal  = (L >= 1) && (L !== state.tailFillerIndex);
        const rightReal = (R >= 1) && (R !== state.tailFillerIndex);
        box.classList.toggle('has-pages', !!(leftReal || rightReal));

        eagerLoad((s+1)*2); eagerLoad((s+1)*2+1);
      }

      function layoutSingle(p){
        box.classList.add('single');
        for (const k in state.nodes){
          const el = state.nodes[k];
          el.style.display='none';
          el.classList.remove('is-current','is-prev','is-next','turning-next','turning-prev');
        }
        const cur=state.nodes[p], prev=state.nodes[p-1], next=state.nodes[p+1];
        if (prev){ prev.style.display='block'; prev.classList.add('is-prev'); }
        if (cur){  cur.style.display='block';  cur.classList.add('is-current'); }
        if (next){ next.style.display='block'; next.classList.add('is-next'); }

        const curReal = (p >= 1) && (p !== state.tailFillerIndex);
        box.classList.toggle('has-pages', !!curReal);
      }

      function updateButtons(){
        if (state.single){
          prevBt.disabled  = state.page<=1;
          nextBt.disabled  = state.page>=TOTAL_PAGES;
          startBt.disabled = state.page===1;
        } else {
          const maxIdx = getMaxSpreadIndex();
          prevBt.disabled  = state.spread<=0;
          nextBt.disabled  = state.spread>=maxIdx;
          startBt.disabled = state.spread===0;
        }
      }

      function ensureSpineVisibility(){
        if (!spineEl) return;
        const show = (!state.single || SHOW_SPINE_ON_SINGLE) && box.classList.contains('has-pages');
        spineEl.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';

        if (edgeLEl) edgeLEl.style.display = (state.single ? 'none' : (box.classList.contains('at-start') ? 'none' : 'block'));
        if (edgeREl) edgeREl.style.display = (state.single ? 'none' : (box.classList.contains('at-end')   ? 'none' : 'block'));
      }

      function eagerLoad(i){
        const el = state.nodes[i]; if (!el) return;
        const img = el.querySelector('img'); if (img && !img.complete){ img.loading='eager'; img.src = img.src; }
      }
      function warmPreload(){
        rICB(() => {
          if (state.single){
            [state.page+1, state.page+2, state.page+3].forEach(preloadImage);
          } else {
            const s = state.spread;
            [(s+1)*2, (s+1)*2+1, (s+2)*2, (s+2)*2+1].forEach(preloadImage);
          }
        });
      }
      function preloadImage(i){
        const last = state.tailFillerIndex || TOTAL_PAGES;
        if (i<1 || i>last || state.loaded.has(i)) return;
        const img = state.nodes[i]?.querySelector('img'); if (!img){ state.loaded.add(i); return; }
        if (img.complete){ state.loaded.add(i); return; }
        const probe = new Image(); probe.decoding='async'; probe.src = img.src;
        probe.onload = probe.onerror = () => state.loaded.add(i);
      }

      function onResize(){
        const wasSingle = state.single;
        state.single = innerWidth < MOBILE_BP;
        box.classList.toggle('single', state.single);

        setBookWidthFromVH();

        if (wasSingle !== state.single){
          if (state.single){
            const p = (state.spread===0)?1:(state.spread*2+1);
            state.page = Math.min(Math.max(1,p), TOTAL_PAGES);
            layoutSingle(state.page);
          } else {
            state.spread = Math.floor((state.page===1?1:state.page)/2);
            layoutSpread(state.spread, 0);
          }
        } else {
          state.single ? layoutSingle(state.page) : layoutSpread(state.spread, 0);
        }

        updateButtons();
        warmPreload();
        ensureSpineVisibility();
      }

      function wireControls(){
        startBt.addEventListener('click', goToStart);
        prevBt .addEventListener('click', () => go(-1));
        nextBt .addEventListener('click', () => go(+1));
        fsBtn  .addEventListener('click', toggleFullscreen);
      }

      function toggleFullscreen(){
        if (!document.fullscreenElement){
          if (book.requestFullscreen) book.requestFullscreen();
        } else {
          if (document.exitFullscreen) document.exitFullscreen();
        }
      }

      function onFullscreenChange(){
        const active = !!document.fullscreenElement;
        book.classList.toggle('fullscreen-active', active);
        fsBtn.textContent = active ? '⛶ Close' : '⛶ Fullscreen';
        fsBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));

        setBookWidthFromVH();
        state.single ? layoutSingle(state.page) : layoutSpread(state.spread, 0);
      }

      // function onKeydown(e){ if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') toggleFullscreen(); }
    })();
    </script>

<script>
(() => {
  const book     = document.getElementById('book');
  const fsBtn    = document.getElementById('fsBtn');
  const dlBtn    = document.getElementById('dlBtn');
  const shareBtn = document.getElementById('shareBtn');

  const popover   = document.getElementById('sharePopover');
  const shareUrl  = document.getElementById('shareUrl');
  const copyBtn   = document.getElementById('copyShareBtn');
  const shareHint = document.getElementById('shareHint');

  const PDF_URL = "https://gamestop.a.bigcontent.io/v1/static/GameStop2026HolidayGiftGuide";

  const isIOSSafari = /iP(hone|od|ad)/.test(navigator.userAgent) &&
                      /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent) &&
                      !/CriOS|FxiOS/.test(navigator.userAgent);

  let pseudoFS = false;

  function updateFSLabel(){
    const active = !!document.fullscreenElement || pseudoFS;
    fsBtn.textContent = active ? '⛶ Close' : '⛶ Fullscreen';
    fsBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  }

  function reflowFlipbook(){
    const api = window.flipbook; if (!api) return;
    api.setBookWidthFromVH?.();
    if (api.state?.single) api.layoutSingle?.(api.state.page);
    else api.layoutSpread?.(api.state.spread, 0);
    api.updateButtons?.();
    api.ensureSpineVisibility?.();
  }

  function applyPseudoFS(on){
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('pseudo-fs', on);
    book.classList.toggle('pseudo-fs', on);
    pseudoFS = on;
    updateFSLabel();
    reflowFlipbook();
  }

  async function requestRealFullscreenWithFallback(){
    // Try real fullscreen first
    if (document.fullscreenEnabled && book.requestFullscreen && !isIOSSafari) {
      try {
        const wait = new Promise(res => {
          const to = setTimeout(res, 500);
          document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => { clearTimeout(to); res(); }, { once:true });
        });
        await book.requestFullscreen();
        await wait; // if this resolves via timeout, fallback will run below
      } catch (_) {
        /* swallow — we’ll decide on fallback next */
      }
      if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
        // Real FS failed on a non-iOS browser; do nothing (no fallback requested)
      }
      return;
    }

    // iOS Safari path: go straight to pseudo FS
    if (isIOSSafari) applyPseudoFS(true);
  }

  fsBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const active = !!document.fullscreenElement || pseudoFS;
    if (active){
      if (document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen?.();
      if (pseudoFS) applyPseudoFS(false);
      return;
    }
    await requestRealFullscreenWithFallback();
  });

  // IMPORTANT: do not toggle .pseudo-fs here — only reflect real FS state
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
    const active = !!document.fullscreenElement;
    book.classList.toggle('fullscreen-active', active);
    updateFSLabel();
    reflowFlipbook();
  });

  // Keep pseudo-FS sized nicely when the URL bar collapses/expands
  (window.visualViewport || window).addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (pseudoFS) reflowFlipbook();
  });

  // ---- Download (unchanged) ----
  dlBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try{
      const res = await fetch(PDF_URL, { mode:'cors', credentials:'omit' });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('network');
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a    = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url; a.download = 'GameStop2026HolidayGiftGuide.pdf';
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast('⬇ Download started');
    }catch{ window.open(PDF_URL, '_blank', 'noopener'); }
  });

  // ---- Share (unchanged) ----
  shareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const willOpen = popover.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'false';
    if (willOpen) {
      shareUrl.value = PDF_URL;
      popover.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      shareBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      shareUrl.focus(); shareUrl.select();
      shareHint.textContent = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform) ? 'Press ⌘C to copy' : 'Press Ctrl+C to copy';
    } else { closeShare(); }
  });

  copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try{
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(PDF_URL);
      copyBtn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      setTimeout(()=>copyBtn.textContent='Copy', 1200);
      toast('📎 Link copied');
    }catch{
      shareUrl.focus(); shareUrl.select();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
    if (!popover.contains(ev.target) && !shareBtn.contains(ev.target)) closeShare();
  }, {capture:true});
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Escape') closeShare(); });

  function closeShare(){
    popover.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    shareBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }

  function toast(msg){
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.textContent = msg;
    Object.assign(el.style, {
      position:'fixed',bottom:'24px',left:'50%',transform:'translateX(-50%)',
      background:'rgba(255,255,255,.96)',color:'#0f1115',padding:'10px 16px',
      borderRadius:'10px',fontWeight:'600',fontSize:'14px',zIndex:'9999',
      boxShadow:'0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'
    });
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),1600);
  }

  updateFSLabel();
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  const banner = document.querySelector('.acc-banner');
  const panel  = document.getElementById('giftguide-panel');
  const pill   = document.querySelector('.acc-toggle-pill');

  banner.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); });
  pill  .addEventListener('click',   (e) => { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); });

  setExpanded(false);

  function toggle(){
    const open = banner.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    setExpanded(!open);
    if (open) {
      panel.classList.remove('is-open');
      panel.addEventListener('transitionend', () => panel.setAttribute('hidden',''), {once:true});
    } else {
      panel.removeAttribute('hidden');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        panel.classList.add('is-open');
        whenPanelSettles(() => safeReflow());
      });
    }
  }

  function setExpanded(expanded){
    banner.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(expanded));
    pill.setAttribute('aria-expanded',   String(expanded));
    pill.textContent = expanded ? 'Close ✕' : 'Shop The Gift Guide ▼';
    pill.classList.toggle('is-bouncing', !expanded);
  }

  function whenPanelSettles(cb){
    let done = false;
    const finish = () => { if (!done){ done = true; cb(); obs?.disconnect(); panel.removeEventListener('transitionend', finish); } };
    panel.addEventListener('transitionend', finish, {once:true});
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{ if(entries[0].isIntersecting) finish(); }, {threshold:0.15});
    obs.observe(panel);
    setTimeout(finish, 600);
  }

  function safeReflow() {
    const api = window.flipbook; if (!api) return;
    const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.height < 8 || r.width < 8) { requestAnimationFrame(safeReflow); return; }
    api.setBookWidthFromVH?.();
    if (api.state?.single) api.layoutSingle?.(api.state.page);
    else                    api.layoutSpread?.(api.state.spread, 0);
    api.updateButtons?.();
    api.ensureSpineVisibility?.();
  }

  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => safeReflow());
  ro.observe(panel);
})();
</script>
